description: This Java source file defines constants and enumerations used for search parameters within the Fineract project, specifically in the portfolio.search package. It includes constant strings for API parameters and enums for various search response parameters, supported parameters, resources, and loan dates.

classes.name: SearchConstants
classes.description: A utility class holding API parameter constant strings and several enums for search-related parameters used throughout the project.

classes.name: SearchConstants.SearchResponseParameters
classes.description: An enum representing response parameters that can be returned in search results, with utility methods to access their string values and all possible values.

classes.name: SearchConstants.SearchSupportedParameters
classes.description: An enum representing supported search query parameters with utility methods for string values and set of all values.

classes.name: SearchConstants.SearchSupportedResources
classes.description: An enum listing resources that can be searched, with utility methods for string representation and retrieving all resource types.

classes.name: SearchConstants.SearchLoanDate
classes.description: An enum representing loan date fields used in searches, with utility methods similar to other enums.

methods.name: SearchResponseParameters.getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set of all string values defined for SearchResponseParameters.

methods.name: SearchSupportedParameters.getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set of all string values defined for SearchSupportedParameters.

methods.name: SearchSupportedResources.getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set of all string values defined for SearchSupportedResources.

methods.name: SearchLoanDate.getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set of all string values defined for SearchLoanDate.
